description: This file contains various functions and configurations for platform-specific upgrade procedures, including firmware preparation, upgrade methods for different device models, and related utilities within a Linux-based embedded system project.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares initramfs environment for Xiaomi devices by formatting relevant MTD partitions if needed.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Removes existing Linux and JFFS2 volumes during the initial setup on ASUS devices.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes specified OEM UBI volume based on the given volume name.

methods.name: tplink_get_boot_part
methods.description: Determines current boot partition either from kernel arguments or U-boot environment.

methods.name: tplink_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade on TP-Link devices, switching boot partitions accordingly.
